changelog: 2026-10-22  session 4: snapshotter, objects/, restore shipped; diff and snapindex.db added
2026-10-22  session 3: adapter, recorder, ledger, agentvcd, hook, wiring, self-protection, foundations, check shipped
2026-10-18  first graph from plan diagrams 4.1-4.3; every node planned

nodes.label: Claude Code
nodes.desc: First supported agent. Hooks are generated per version from agentvc/wiring.py (2.1.72 and 2.1.302 captured); installing them into the agent's settings comes in v0.1.

nodes.label: Codex
nodes.desc: Second agent (v0.2).

nodes.label: Gemini CLI / Cursor / Copilot
nodes.desc: Further hook-based agents (v0.5).

nodes.label: Any CLI agent
nodes.desc: Agents without hooks, wrapped by agentvc run (v0.5).

nodes.label: MCP clients
nodes.desc: Agents that call MCP servers through AgentVC's proxy (v0.4).

nodes.label: Agent adapters
nodes.desc: agentvc/adapters/claude_code.py turns Claude Code hook payloads into one event model, tested only against captured payloads (2.1.72, 2.1.302). File contents are reduced to their size, commands scrubbed, prompts kept only if enabled. Unreadable payloads go to the blind-spot log.

nodes.label: Run wrapper
nodes.desc: Records agents that have no hooks by snapshotting around the whole command (v0.5).

nodes.label: MCP proxy
nodes.desc: Sits between an agent and its MCP servers; classifies calls and stages stageable ones in the outbox (v0.4).

nodes.label: Step recorder
nodes.sub: pending step, then recorded or GAP
nodes.desc: Turns events into runs, turns and steps. Runs are keyed on (agent, session id) inside one workspace. A Pre without a Post, and a Post without a Pre, become visible GAPs (ADR-0004); PostToolBatch reconciles; denied actions are DENIED steps. A step's snapshot row is written in the same transaction.

nodes.label: Snapshotter
nodes.desc: Before and after snapshots per step: edit tools capture only their targets, shell, MCP and unknown tools the whole workspace. Never follows links; nested repositories, heavy ignored folders, unreadable, oversized and torn files are listed as unprotected. Budgets per ADR-0006/0010; the first snapshot is built in agentvcd's background. Records outside changes between steps.

nodes.label: Effect classifier
nodes.desc: Classifies each action's external effects into recovery classes using contracts (v0.2). When unsure: UNKNOWN.

nodes.label: Restore
nodes.desc: rollback, rollback --undo, undo, redo, repair. Per file, the agent's changes are undone newest first while the file still holds what the agent left; outside changes are never rolled back. Saves the current state first, writes an intent record, compare-and-swap on every write, refuses paths through links; an interrupted rollback is finished by repair.

nodes.label: Compensator
nodes.desc: Runs compensations for compensatable effects after the user confirms (v0.2+).

nodes.label: Replay / fork / fence
nodes.desc: Replays or forks a run; the fence blocks effects the parent already performed (G4, v0.3).

nodes.label: Outbox
nodes.desc: Holds stageable effects until commit; releases each exactly once (G5, v0.4).

nodes.label: ledger.db
nodes.desc: SQLite (WAL) ledger: an append-only, hash-chained entries table and materialised runs, turns, steps, snapshots and rollbacks checked against it. schema_version + migrations tables (ADR-0007); schema 2 added snapshots and rollbacks. verify() reports tampering, truncation and corruption, never repairs.

nodes.label: objects/
nodes.desc: AgentVC's own git object store, written by AgentVC as loose objects (readable by any git). No alternates; every snapshot tree pinned by a ref; hashes checked on every read.

nodes.label: contracts/
nodes.desc: One YAML file per kind of effect: class, detection, undo, idempotency, outcome check (v0.2).

nodes.label: CLI
nodes.desc: Shipped: history, inspect, diff, rollback (--undo, --force), undo, redo, repair, check (each with --json), hooks-config. Next: status, gc (v0.1); replay, fork (v0.3); review, commit, abort (v0.4).

nodes.label: Reports
nodes.desc: Run reports, including the offline HTML timeline (v0.2).

nodes.label: Health
nodes.desc: check (shipped) sends a realistic tool call through the real hook path, and a Post without a Pre that must come back as a GAP. ready and selftest follow in v0.2.

nodes.label: Hook wiring
nodes.desc: The single list of events and tools. Generates the Claude Code hook settings per version: only events that version knows (FM-INS-03), http hooks to 127.0.0.1 where supported, command hooks by absolute interpreter with -I.

nodes.label: agentvcd
nodes.desc: Background process per workspace that receives http hooks and keeps the snapshot index warm. Exclusive bind, a port outside the ephemeral range, token and Host checked. Builds the first snapshot in a background thread. Started and checked once per prompt by the liveness command hook, which also reports gaps, missed snapshots and interrupted rollbacks.

nodes.label: Hook handler
nodes.sub: one event in, one reply out
nodes.desc: Shared by agentvcd and the per-call command hook. Runs under a 5 s deadline: takes the step's snapshot within its budget, records, replies. Fails open with a message and a GAP, or blocks PreToolUse in strict mode, including when its snapshot failed (ADR-0004).

nodes.label: Self-protection
nodes.desc: PreToolUse denies edit tools targeting the store (paths resolved) and shell commands naming it, in every mode (G8).

nodes.label: Foundations
nodes.desc: One I/O layer with fault injection, atomic writes and locks, bounded subprocesses (job objects on Windows); injectable clock and randomness; named crash points; secret scrubber; AGENTVC_DEBUG log (plan §16.4).

nodes.label: blindspots.jsonl
nodes.desc: One line per unreadable payload or misplaced event: the reason and the payload's shape, never its content. Reported at the next prompt.

nodes.label: ~/.agentvc/anchors/
nodes.desc: Holds the newest entry's hash (and the pending one before each commit) so rewrites, truncation and forged entries are detected (plan §14.1).

nodes.label: diff
nodes.sub: unified diffs per step, turn or run
nodes.desc: What a step, a turn or a run changed, from its snapshots, as unified diffs; also lists changes made outside the agent and steps that weren't captured.

nodes.label: snapindex.db
nodes.sub: stat cache of the last snapshot
nodes.desc: Path to size, times, mode and blob, plus ignore results, so unchanged files aren't read again. A cache: racy entries re-read, never trusted by restore (ADR-0010).

dataflow.label: PreToolUse as an http hook (127.0.0.1, token)
parse into one event; deny writes into .agentvc/
class, e.g. IRREVERSIBLE (ask if policy says so)
snapshot before (edit targets, or the workspace)
write pending step + snapshot row (outside changes)
complete step + effects; no Post = visible GAP

roadmap.title: Undo for files and shell (v0.1-alpha)
roadmap.goal: Record every Claude Code action and roll back workspace changes, including shell changes, without ever overwriting user work.
acceptance: 0 data-loss failures across scenario, property and model-based tests
roadmap.first_contribution: Not open yet: contributions are closed during the alpha.

roadmap.title: Approve before it leaves (v0.4)
roadmap.goal: Hold stageable MCP calls in an outbox until the user commits, releasing each exactly once.
acceptance: a crash during commit never sends twice
